answer: Mechanism: Continuity Beacon. An agent periodically computes a sequential VDF over atlas-supplied randomness plus its private seed, emitting a signed pulse chained to prior pulses; the latest checkpoint lives in a hardware-backed vault. Clones cannot reuse pulses because each seed differs, and copying the vault breaks the chain. Attack cost scales with full time-delay compute per clone, while an honest agent pays one low-power continuous pulse—so cloning is slower and costlier than staying honest.
